goals.goal: Personal data at rest in TinyTask's managed-cloud storage (customer account metadata and customer task data) is maintained under encryption with key custody logically separated from data access, calibrated to the five Art. 32(1) preamble factors in the company's risk assessment.
goals.adjustment: Restated from the corpus "appropriate technical measures" to TinyTask's 8-person managed-cloud deployment where the company acts as both controller (customer accounts) and processor (customer task data); the "appropriate" threshold is operationalised through the five Art. 32(1) preamble factors in the company's risk assessment, and managed-cloud hosting means technical implementation is partly delegated while the obligation remains with TinyTask.

goals.goal: The TinyTask SaaS product (web and mobile interface) maintains state-of-the-art encryption of all stored data — personal or other — at the product level, rendering data unintelligible to any person not authorised to access it, with key custody functionally separated by role-based access control.
goals.source: CRA Annex I Part I (1); Annex I Part I (2)(e)
goals.adjustment: Restated from the corpus baseline to TinyTask's role as manufacturer of a default-class product with digital elements under self-assessment conformity; the state-of-the-art floor is a product-level obligation distinct from the GDPR deployment-level obligation, and the "render unintelligible" test applies to all data stored by the product (not only personal data).
